---
title: "Comisiones / Viáticos"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Comisiones / Viáticos</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Separa lo gastado, facturado, reconocido y reembolsado sin convertir el reembolso en ingreso personal.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
</div>

<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2">
  <section class="tf-card">
    <h2>Nueva comisión</h2>
    <form id="trip-form" class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Comisión / proyecto</label><input id="trip-name" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Destino</label><input id="trip-destination"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio</label><input id="trip-start" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fin</label><input id="trip-end" type="date"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Entidad que reembolsa</label><input id="trip-reimburser"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Financiamiento</label><select id="trip-funding"><option value="own_funds">Fondos propios</option><option value="advance">Anticipo de viáticos</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-notes"></div>
      <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Crear comisión</button></div>
    </form>
  </section>

  <section class="tf-card">
    <h2>Comisión activa</h2>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Seleccionar</label><select id="trip-select"></select></div>
    <div id="trip-selected-meta" class="tf-muted" style="margin-top:.6rem"></div>
    <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.8rem">
      <button id="trip-mark-submitted" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Marcar presentado</button>
      <button id="trip-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar comisión</button>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<section class="tf-trip-kpis" aria-label="Resumen de comisión">
  <div class="tf-card"><span>Gastado</span><strong id="trip-spent">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-card"><span>Facturado</span><strong id="trip-invoiced">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-card"><span>Reconocido</span><strong id="trip-recognized">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-card"><span>Fondos recibidos</span><strong id="trip-received">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-card tf-trip-kpi-pending"><span>Por recuperar</span><strong id="trip-pending">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-card"><span>Costo personal esperado</span><strong id="trip-personal">$0,00</strong></div>
</section>

<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <section class="tf-card">
    <h2>Registrar gasto</h2>
    <form id="trip-expense-form" class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="trip-expense-date" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="trip-expense-category"><option value="food">Alimentación</option><option value="lodging">Hospedaje</option><option value="transport">Transporte</option><option value="fuel">Combustible</option><option value="tolls">Peajes</option><option value="other">Otros</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><input id="trip-expense-description"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Gastado realmente ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-paid" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta usada</label><select id="trip-expense-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-check"><input id="trip-expense-invoice" type="checkbox"><label>Tiene factura / comprobante</label></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Número de factura</label><input id="trip-expense-invoice-number"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Valor facturado ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-invoiced" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Valor reconocido ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-recognized" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-expense-notes"></div>
      <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar gasto</button></div>
    </form>
  </section>

  <section class="tf-card">
    <h2>Reembolso / anticipo</h2>
    <form id="trip-settlement-form" class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="trip-settlement-kind"><option value="reimbursement">Reembolso recibido</option><option value="advance">Anticipo recibido</option><option value="advance_return">Devolución de anticipo</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="trip-settlement-date" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Monto ($)</label><input id="trip-settlement-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="trip-settlement-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-settlement-notes"></div>
      <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar movimiento</button></div>
    </form>

    <div class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem">
      Reembolsos y anticipos modifican el saldo de la cuenta, pero no se consideran ingresos personales. Los gastos de comisión tampoco se mezclan con consumo personal.
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><h2>Gastos de la comisión</h2><div class="tf-muted">Puedes corregir posteriormente el valor reconocido por la entidad.</div></div></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Detalle</th><th>Gastado</th><th>Facturado</th><th>Reconocido</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="trip-expense-body"></tbody></table></div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <h2>Reembolsos y anticipos</h2>
  <div id="trip-settlement-list"></div>
</section>

<script type="module" src="js/business-trips.js"></script>
```
